name: Aleth-NeRF
definition: A NeRF variant that trains on under- and over-exposed images to render normal-light novel views by introducing a 'Concealing Field' assumption, where air particles attenuate emission rather than objects lacking emission.
summary: Aleth-NeRF renders normal-light views from under- or over-exposed 8-bit images by modeling illumination-adaptive volume rendering through local and global concealing fields.
